title: Hydraulic Pressure — Low
description: Hydraulic pressure P050 = {val} bar, below minimum operating pressure ({val2} bar). Workholding and ATC clamp functions may be unreliable.
probable_cause: Pump wear, pressure relief valve stuck open, or internal leak in hydraulic circuit.
diagnostic_steps: Check pump outlet pressure with calibrated gauge
Inspect hydraulic hoses and fittings for leaks
remedy: Replace pump if output pressure confirmed low. Set relief valve to correct pressure. Repair leaks.
required_action: Stop current operation. Machine must be inspected before resuming production.
escalation_path: If HYD-MJ-001 is not addressed (stop current operation. machine must be inspected before resuming production.), the fault will escalate in this order: TCS-MJ-001, then HYD-SR-001, then HYD-CR-phantom. Each subsequent code represents a more severe fault state requiring more urgent intervention. Query each related code for its specific thresholds and required actions.
